# unreal-asm test data

Part of the library (decision D-14): every codec and plugin is tested on the files here.

| Folder | Content | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `text/` | One Z80 source with Russian comments in CP866, KOI8-R, CP1251 and UTF-8, each with LF, CRLF and CR line ends; layout cases (byte-order mark, no final break, mixed ends, an invalid UTF-8 byte, empty lines, an empty file); `source.utf8.txt` = the expected decoded text | generated by `text/generate.py` (run it to regenerate; the files are committed) |
| `sjasmplus/` | `hello.asm` and `module.asm` use sjasmplus-only directives (`DEVICE`, `SAVESNA`, `MODULE`, `OUTPUT`, ...); `plain.asm` has none | written for these tests (sjasmplus syntax from its documentation) |
| `tasm3/` | `000LOAD.$A`, `CALLLOAD.$A`: hobeta files of TASM 3.2 sources (TR-DOS type `A`, start 40872); `*.txt` = their expected decoded text | the files come with the TASM 3.2 disk image (`TASM3_2.SCL`); the `.txt` files are the `tasm3` codec's output, checked line by line against an independent converter (prior-art L2; it re-aligns columns, otherwise identical apart from two of its own duplication errors). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-tasm.md` |

| `alasm/` | Ten ALASM sources (hobeta, type `H`) covering every version range the codec reports and the special cases of research-alasm.md §5; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `ZADACHA` from [ALASM 3.8c](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:406950/ALASM38c.zip) (`al38c_.scl`); `SCR4MAKE`, `128KDRV`, `fibo`, `SNAKE`, `BUILD+` from [ALASM 5.09](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249271/ALASM509.zip); `2Kolonki` from [ACE 1.02 sources](http://alonecoder.nedopc.com/zx/ACE102SRC.rar); `RECPIC` from The Link's working disk (`testdata/machines/pentagon1024sl/TheLink.trd` in unreal-ng); `AL442nfo` from [ALASM 4.42](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:408359/Alasm442.SCL); `AL444nfo` from [ALASM 4.44](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249270/ALASM444.ZIP). Extracted unchanged (file bytes up to the catalog length, rewrapped as hobeta) |

Each new codec adds its folder with files produced by the real assembler and a README section saying how they were
made (source-formats.md §3 of the design).
